issue.description:
## Scope
Test concurrent replay scenarios, stale fencing, and revision handling under race conditions.

## Tasks
- Write tests for concurrent replay of the same attempt
- Write tests for stale fencing (rejecting updates based on old revision)
- Write tests for optimistic concurrency with revision numbers
- Test race conditions between multiple workers
- Add stress tests with high concurrency levels
- Verify fencing prevents lost updates and double-claims

## Acceptance
- tests/concurrency.rs covers all concurrency scenarios
- Concurrent replay tests pass with proper locking/fencing
- Stale fencing tests reject out-of-date updates
- Revision-based optimistic concurrency works correctly
- Stress tests with 10+ concurrent workers pass reliably
- No lost updates or double-claims detected in any test
- cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo test pass
issue.title: Implement concurrency tests for replay and fencing
